lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Start track recording, Force Stop or reboot, reopen app
Start walk digitizing a line, swipe the app away while editing geometry, reopen it even if Android has already restarted WalkEditService
Simulate a walk owner at initial revision with no persisted snapshot and no running service, then reopen the app
Leave a persisted walk owned by another project, switch projects, reopen, choose emergency reset, and verify General settings offers the same reset while state exists
On a cold start press walk Continue immediately, before map layers or edit sources finish loading
Draw a polygon manually, append it by walk from a middle node, swipe the app away, choose Continue, receive more GPS fixes, then Stop the walk
After restoring the walk, verify no second manual-geometry recovery prompt is offered for the same sketch
Repeat cold walk recovery with LineString and MultiLineString after a polygon recovery
Create a line with the normal vertex editor, move/add vertices, swipe the app away before saving geometry, reopen and choose Continue
Repeat with a partly drawn Polygon and MultiPolygon, choose Continue, then move several different restored nodes
Repeat normal line editing for an existing feature, choose Discard after reopening
Fill attribute form with fields/photos, Force Stop, reopen app
After recovering geometry for a new line, open its attribute form, swipe the app away, recover the form, press Save
For walk/manual geometry/form choose Continue then Discard on a second run
Add a point with unchanged default attributes, press Save, return to the map, then restart the app
value.expected: Track recording auto-resumes without a dialog and previous trackpoints remain; finish is only via Stop track menu. Walk draft offers Continue/Discard and Continue never crashes when selected before MapLibre edit sources exist; renderer attachment is deferred and then restores vertices and GPS writing even when its sticky service was already restarted. Walk and point geometry have different durable owners; a transferred sketch is offered once; a recovered polygon keeps one stable fill and red outline through later GPS updates, and Stop immediately republishes all editable vertices and midpoints; recovered line types show only an open red line without polygon fill and retain that geometry after Stop and Save; Cancel/Save does not re-offer. Normal vertex/tap editing offers its own Continue/Discard dialog; Continue restores the latest visible geometry in the same map, layer and feature while Discard clears it. Restored polygon fill and nodes agree before and after moving any restored node, with one outer fill and no invented duplicate hole. Form Continue restores fields/photos and Save persists and returns to the correct layer without depending on the pre-crash map selection or crashing; the newly inserted geometry appears on the map without an app restart, and Discard clears the draft. Saving a new point with unchanged defaults never creates or re-offers an attribute-form draft. An unacknowledged empty walk start is removed silently; a real foreign-map owner is never hidden and its confirmed emergency reset clears only walk-owned transient state.
